text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, big brother...
It's just a little injury... ouch.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, big sister...
It's just a little injury... ouch.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine... An injury like this is nothing...
Rice can still train...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So please don't worry, Brother...!
choice_data_list: Even if you say that, I'm still worried...
What will you do if it gets worse?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So please don't worry, Sister...!
choice_data_list: Even if you say that, I'm still worried...
Even if you say that, I'm still worried...
What will you do if it gets worse?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry.
Rice didn't mean to...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice just... wanted you to know
that she could try even harder, Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice just... wanted you to know
that she could try even harder, Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Thank you, Big Brother.
Well then, Rice is going to go to sleep now...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Thank you, Big Sister.
Well then, Rice is going to go to sleep now...
She took time off to let her injury heal, but it proved more severe than anticipated, and making a full recovery took quite some time...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Auugh... Right, of course...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I wonder if there's any training
I can do while lying down...?”

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right, if it's just upper body exercise—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
*sigh*... Why does Rice always, always do this...

Though Rice Shower took some time to rest,
her condition didn't bounce back for a while...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, if I stop here,
all the training I've done so far will go to waste."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Something like that... I don't want it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So, Brother...!
Once my injury heals, right away, we'll train...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So, Sister...!
Once my injury heals, right away, we'll train...!

I saw determination in Rice Shower's eyes.
It seemed she had gained something from this incident.
